limitations: Firefox, Safari, physical touch and assistive technology were not available for independent verification.
Artwork motion checks verify resource/work counters and source lifecycle; they are not a complete perceptual assessment of every animation frame.
Browser theme checks cover geometry and registered CSS properties, not all contrast ratios of every neon gradient.
Full catalog, final packed artifact and React 18/19 consumer checks are performed by the parent after this source freeze.

publicUtilities.basis: Case-sensitive comparison of root runtime exports against all public React components regardless of source directory, including core LocaleProvider and SvgAsset. Subpath entry points are recorded for each symbol. Public type declarations are inventoried separately by the TypeScript compiler.
publicUtilities.outcome: The final utility pass confirmed and repaired four inherited-key defects. Other entries below distinguish direct/consumer tests from source-only review. The final release build is owned by the parent.

groups.contract: Compose component classes and root attributes, normalize legacy sizes, create structural parts and the shared native button view.
groups.coverage: Source review; indirect coverage through component suites, ReleaseContracts root attribute checks and packed consumer button/ref checks.
groups.limits: Not every factory argument has a dedicated direct utility test.

groups.contract: Write a DOM node or null to a callback ref or mutable object ref.
groups.coverage: Source review and indirect element-ref consumer tests.
groups.limits: No independent callback-ref lifecycle test for arbitrary consumer callbacks.

groups.contract: Use the controlled prop when present, otherwise internal initial state; stable setter accepts value/updater and emits only changed requests against the current state.
groups.coverage: ReleaseContracts rejected controlled requests and same-event uncontrolled updates; control, tabs and dialog suites.
groups.limits: Changing between controlled and uncontrolled modes after mount is not promised as a reset mechanism.

groups.contract: Clamp a numeric value (non-finite value falls back to min); convert CSS pixels using document root font size; format finite seconds as nonnegative m:ss.
groups.coverage: Source-only direct utility review; clamp/time formatting have broad indirect control/media coverage.
groups.limits: cssRem needs a DOM; finite time values and ordered min/max bounds are caller preconditions. No SSR promise or general date/time formatter.

groups.contract: Copy text with clipboard API and DOM fallback; download text via a Blob/object URL and revoke the URL after the click.
groups.coverage: base.test.ts copy fallback geometry; source review of focus restoration, fallback removal and delayed URL release; ThemeEditor now reuses downloadFile.
groups.limits: OS clipboard permissions and download UI were not independently exercised in every browser.

groups.contract: Create a pointer-centered CSS ripple only while motion is enabled; remove its node on completion or cancellation.
groups.coverage: ReleaseContracts disabled-motion node budget and animationcancel cleanup; browser button use.
groups.limits: Relies on the shipped component CSS animation.

groups.contract: Render trusted VectorNode artwork recursively, scope IDs and url/href references, expose built-in asset maps and labelled/decorative SVG wrappers.
groups.coverage: Source review of recursive ID/reference scoping; SVG use across component/browser suites. Icon fallback now has three dedicated SSR regressions for constructor/toString/__proto__.
groups.limits: vectorElement is a rendering utility for trusted node data, with no HTML sanitization contract; full arbitrary SVG grammar is not tested.

groups.contract: Four primary/secondary pairs, CSS typography references, default editable config and the supported editor token groups.
groups.coverage: Source-to-token cross-reference, theme-following suite, four themes times dark/light browser cases; static data reviewed.
groups.limits: Token values are exported data, not immutable runtime guards. Full color-contrast matrix is not measured.

groups.contract: Derive a companion for six-digit hex; serialize/stamp theme JSON; parse supported version/name/known token values; produce ThemeProvider props; resolve a token in a real DOM scope.
groups.coverage: FoundationContracts import ordering, malformed/inherited theme names and error reporting; theme-following consumers; source review of token filtering and DOM probe cleanup.
groups.limits: resolveToken needs DOM and Canvas2D for color conversion and returns #000000 without a context; not an SSR utility. Editor exposes its documented subset of tokens.

groups.contract: Thirteen known animation names and localized labels, shared animation CSS, embedded default SVG and escaped standalone HTML export from loader settings.
groups.coverage: LoaderGenerator.test.ts export escaping/processing contracts; LoaderMotionPerformance; theme-following; source consistency.
groups.limits: Standalone exports use their own page CSS. Per-frame perceptual quality of all thirteen animations was not individually scored.

groups.contract: Normalize three/six-digit hex strings; convert RGB hex to hue/saturation/value and normalized HSV back to hex. Invalid hex falls back to ruby when converting to HSV.
groups.coverage: Source-only arithmetic review plus ColorPicker interaction/keyboard contracts.
groups.limits: hsvToHex expects finite hue and normalized saturation/value supplied by the picker; arbitrary malformed numeric tuples are not a normalization API.

groups.contract: Subscribe to system reduced motion and to the document's explicit data-ad-motion override; release the shared listeners after the last subscriber.
groups.coverage: motion-idle and MediaContracts reduced-motion/offscreen cases; source subscription lifecycle; browser reduced-motion dialog/popover checks.
groups.limits: The explicit motion override is document-scoped, not an independent React provider per subtree.

groups.contract: React resource owners for shared border/shape/decorative clocks, visibility boundaries, live callbacks and optional mouse-wheel smoothing.
groups.coverage: motion-idle ownership, hidden/offscreen sleep/resume, 95-scope batching and wheel interception cases; AnimatedBorderGeometry and consumer effects tests.
groups.limits: useSmoothWheel retains the existing contained-scroll behavior at bounds; physical trackpads and nested touchscreen scrolling were not independently verified.

groups.contract: Read diagnostic scheduler counts; configure the shared frame rate in the supported 1–120 range; subscribe to clock ticks and receive an unsubscribe function.
groups.coverage: motion-idle subscriber/cleanup/sleep tests and performance counters; frame-rate assignment source review.
groups.limits: Shared global settings affect all consumers of the package. No independent direct test of malformed non-finite frame-rate input.

groups.contract: Decode URL/Blob audio into normalized peak/RMS bins; null while loading, empty data on errors; abort superseded fetch/work and yield between CPU slices.

groups.limits: Real decoding support remains browser/audio-format dependent; caller-supplied audio is not uploaded.

groups.contract: First matching static/parameter/wildcard route; decoded string params; current router context with navigation, access and optional view transitions.
groups.coverage: RouterRerenders, EdgeCases malformed percent-encoding, LayoutNavigation mode change; new prototype-like parameter-name regression.
groups.limits: Browser router requires location/history. Parameter dictionaries now have a null prototype so __proto__ is retained as data.

groups.contract: Form state, dotted field paths, touched/errors/reset/async validation and submit locking; context boundary; fourteen predefined field bindings with overridable components.
groups.coverage: EdgeCases, ControlsContracts, base FormFields cases; three new untouched/touch/reset regressions for prototype-like field names.
groups.limits: Form values and initialValues should be immutable; custom field renderers/validators retain their own cost and failure behavior.

groups.contract: Imperative default locale and isolated provider-local translations, custom dictionaries, own-key placeholder substitution, built-in English/Ukrainian translations of Russian originals; Slavic one/few/many and explicit English one/many.
groups.coverage: base locale isolation; eight new dedicated inherited message/locale/placeholder cases; Controls/Feedback/Foundation consumer suites.
groups.limits: setLocale applies to subsequent renders rather than forcing all mounted roots to render. Custom locale pluralization uses the existing Slavic rules unless the code is exactly en; no general Intl plural-rules promise.

tokens.contract: theme/tokens.css declares scoped CSS custom properties; exported tokens.css and styles.css provide the same token graph; component states consume shared size, tone, motion, typography, surface and palette variables.
tokens.coverage: All declarations enumerated in library-inventory.json; typography references checked against declaration names; ThemeProvider CSSOM five color registrations and eight theme/scheme browser cases; package CSS and font consumer verification owned by parent.
tokens.limits: Not all token combinations were evaluated or contrast-scored. ThemeEditor deliberately lists the token groups it supports instead of promising an arbitrary custom-token editor.
